scope: contact-state labels for: contact (reliability between two reviewers, so usable where reviewed; automated labels for every episode: contact BLOCKED, first touch BLOCKED, touch type BLOCKED, control BLOCKED, tip chain BLOCKED)

control.unmet: both name the controller (share of subset); frame within 3

first touch.unmet: both name the player (share of subset); same player; frame within 3

test_command: Rscript src/rebounding/run_tests.R unit contact_states; Rscript src/rebounding/run_tests.R gates step_02
acceptance_criteria_version: manual 2026-10-29, config v3 (step02, fixed 2026-10-29 before the held-aside subset was opened)

5.measure: agreement where both name rim or board (not gated)

6.measure: both name the player (share of subset)

11.measure: both name the controller (share of subset)

14.measure: episodes with a tip by either labeler

labelers.a: automated labeler auto_v1, frozen before the held-aside pages were drawn
labelers.b: reviewer 1 (Claude), tracking plots only, blind to the labeler and to the credited rebounder
labelers.second_human_reviewer: done (reviewer 2, the owner): the gate is judged on reviewer 1 vs reviewer 2

deviations.check: break threshold: 99.5th percentile of one-step residuals on misses before the contact proxy (prespecified)
deviations.result: 2.20 ft (median residual 0.15 ft): 11% of those segments are not free flight
deviations.decision: Replaced before any label was reviewed: made shots, release + 3 to endFrame - 3, flights with a residual above 1 ft excluded (35 of 346), 99th percentile: 0.65 ft. Owner to confirm.

deviations.check: second reviewer on the held-aside subset (manual: where practical)
deviations.result: added 2026-11-05: the owner labelled the held-aside subset (reviewer2_heldout.csv)
deviations.decision: Gate judged on reviewer 1 vs reviewer 2, as written before scoring. Both read the same tracking plots (no video), so agreement is consistency of tracking-based judgements, not accuracy. Automated-label status is reported separately (automated_labels_by_type).

deviations.check: contact kind kappa over rim / board / none (prespecified)
deviations.result: the widened rim zone overlaps the board zone
deviations.decision: Changed before freezing to contact vs none; rim vs board reported, not gated.

reviewer: Claude (labeler author and blind reviewer 1); the owner (reviewer 2)
open_risks: No video: every label, the reviewer's included, comes from the same tracking
The reviewer wrote the labeler; the two labelers are not independent in method
30 held-aside episodes: wide intervals on every agreement measure
Ball heights near the rim read 1-2 ft high, and the control rule caps ball height at 9 ft, so control heights are truncated
decision_note: Usable label types: contact. Reviewed labels only: the automated labels of these types do not meet the targets against the reviewers, so models that need them on every episode stay blocked.
